authentication: Existing authenticated Harness owner connection; POST requires same-origin. Global Settings administration, never project-context or model-tool authority.

requests.GET: Status/inventory without selector; ?operationId=<32hex> or ?planId=<32hex> returns/reconciles that exact durable receipt, never latest. Both selectors may be supplied only if they identify the same operation. Unknown selector: 404 CLEANUP_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND; malformed selector: 400 CLEANUP_REQUEST_INVALID.

body.selections: optional array<{kind:container|image,id:string}>; absent selects all eligible

Resource.eligible: boolean; manual eligibility, NOT_ARCHIVED alone never blocks manual choice
Resource.automaticEligible: boolean; eligible AND authoritative owners archived/unpinned
Resource.displayName: bounded text: container name or known image tag, otherwise ID
Resource.chatNames: string[]; known authoritative session titles, may be empty

Operation.planId: 32hex; original consumed plan, null for legacy operation
Operation.planHash: 64hex; original plan hash, null for legacy operation
Operation.selection: {kind,id}[]; original canonical selected set sorted by kind:id, null for legacy operation

safety: Verified control-plane ownership; labels alone insufficient
Non-force ID DELETE; image graph re-read after containers
Durable intent and uncertain outcome reconciliation
uiNotes: Image dependencies must be selected with the image
eligible describes manual Settings choice, automaticEligible restricts automatic runs to archived chats
Render displayName/tags/projectNames/chatNames as text, never raw HTML
On selected GET verify operation.id/planId echo; after lost apply use original planId, never infer completion from global latest.
idempotency: Before first DELETE, persist planId + planHash + canonical selection -> one operation ID. Exact apply retry returns its saved receipt without DELETE, including after a new preview/operation, plan expiry or restart. Different hash/selection for consumed plan: 409 CLEANUP_PLAN_CONSUMED. Recover a lost apply response by GET ?planId=<original>; validate operation.planId/planHash/selection and operation.id echo. Receipts are not replaced by later operations.
